title: DaKanji extension of the Yomitan index.json
description: Keys DaKanji reads from index.json on top of dictionary-index-schema.json.

exampleTokenization.description: For an example dictionary: the author wrote every searchable word form as inline markup, so the language processor derives none. Any other value is ignored.

minimumDaLangVersion.description: Oldest DaLang (and so app) version that reads every file of this dictionary, e.g. "4.0". Set for DaKanji formats, from the schema version the dictionary was built against; an older app refuses the import instead of misreading it.
